name: Gem Terminal Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: GEM Terminal Industry Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells electrical terminals in Asia. It offers multi-gauge materials for automobiles, high and low voltage connectors, and automotive wiring harness connectors; and special new type same material processing products, such as copper and copper rods, brass bars, and busbar materials. The company also provides new energy and green energy products that include new energy series and environmentally friendly; AC power cord connectors; wire harness connectors, including electrical wiring harness and electronic connectors; and electrical terminals. GEM Terminal Industry Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
